content.en:
### Menu on the left

Content, media, structure, users and settings are grouped. The current section is highlighted.

### Pages and posts

Pages are for permanent sections of the site (about, contacts). Posts are for the news feed and articles.

### Saving

Changes are stored in the browser. Save keeps your edits, Publish makes the material visible.

excerpt.en: How the admin is laid out and where to start.
